source_basis: Saints-Hebrew-Critical-Text (Studio v10 Stage 1 a0d022c1; MAM Aleppo + WLC Leningrad)
source_verification: MT Exod 32:9 (וַיֹּאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה רָאִיתִי אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה וְהִנֵּה עַם־קְשֵׁה־עֹרֶף הוּא) explicitly opens a second divine speech continuing directly into 32:10 (וְעַתָּה הַנִּיחָה לִּי...). Closing speech 1 at native_verses[32:8] and leaving native_verses[32:9] open into 32:10 resolves the MT quote-stack collision while keeping Saints display (verses[32:8] + self-contained unplaced 32:9) balanced.
applied_changes: Closed outer double quote at native_verses[32:8] (...'" ), removed premature closing double quote at native_verses[32:9], preserved Saints verses[32:8] and self-contained unplaced[32:9], and added concise reader notes on 32:8 and unplaced 32:9.

source_basis: Saints-Hebrew-Critical-Text (Studio v10 Stage 1 a0d022c1; MAM Aleppo + WLC Leningrad)
source_verification: MT Jer 11:7 uses 2mp suffix בַּאֲבוֹתֵיכֶם ("your [pl.] fathers"), matching 2mp addressee Judah/Jerusalem inside the inner proclamation of 11:4 and 11:6 rather than 2ms Jeremiah (11:6 קְרָא), proving 11:7-8 belongs inside the single-quoted proclamation to Judah/Jerusalem.
applied_changes: Removed premature closing single quote at 11:6 and closed '" at 11:8 in both verses and native_verses, making 11:7 "Listen to My voice." valid 3rd-level double quotes inside single quotes inside double quotes in MT order and cleanly balanced in Saints order.

source_basis: Saints-Hebrew-Critical-Text (Studio v10 Stage 1 a0d022c1; MAM Aleppo + WLC Leningrad)
source_verification: MT Job 29:1 opens Job's final discourse with no new speaker formula until the athnach-delimited narrator colophon in 31:40b (תַּמּוּ דִּבְרֵי אִיּוֹב, "The words of Job are finished."). Only two embedded quotations occur in chs. 30-31 (31:24 and 31:31).
applied_changes: Enclosed Job 30:1-31 and 31:1-40a in outer double quotes (both verses and native_verses), downgraded 31:24 and 31:31 embedded quotes to single quotes, and closed " immediately after "barley." before the narrator colophon in 31:40b.

source_verification: MT Deut 32:20-27 carries 1cs divine speech (אָגוּר in v. 27), 32:28-33 lacks 1cs divine pronouns and shifts to 1cp ("our Rock ... our enemies," v. 31), and 32:34-35 abruptly resumes 1cs divine voice (עִמָּדִי, בְּאוֹצְרֹתָי, לִי נָקָם) with no speech-intro formula before 3ms returns in v. 36. Both speaker boundaries and the referent of "they" in vv. 28-33 (Israel vs. enemies) are genuinely debated.
applied_changes: Per Charter Rules 1, 4, and 5, left main-text quotation boundaries unchanged, added neutral Rule 4 ambiguity notes on 32:28 and 32:34 (notes and native_notes), and escalated to pass2_human_editor_queue.jsonl as HEB-HQ-042.
